cases.name: test-spawn-child-normal
cases.description: Verifies that a basic external binary is successfully requested for execution with arguments.
cases.expected_behavior: The runtime successfully initiates the requested external process without returning an immediate invocation error.

cases.name: test-spawn-child-edge
cases.description: Verifies behavior when spawning a command with an empty or minimal argument list.
cases.expected_behavior: The system processes the invocation request correctly even when no additional arguments are supplied.

cases.name: test-spawn-child-oracle
cases.description: Fuzzed verification of process spawn invocation parameters against structural assumptions.
cases.expected_behavior: The process launcher correctly handles varied argument combinations during initiation.
